verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs say events are indexed automatically on every field at ingest and queryable without a predefined schema, so no index definition or pre-aggregation is needed. The query model also includes WHERE and GROUP BY clauses for filtering and grouping. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses high-cardinality fields such as user id or request id, so that central part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that grouping and filtering on high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) is supported and performant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first
